threads.body: [Testing] The updated assertions in both shared Redisson test classes expose the index but still hide the `null` expectation. `.github/instructions/java-tests.instructions.md:162–173` calls for short conditional expectations directly in assertions. Use `hasDatabaseIndex() ? "0" : null` (or `"1"` for the configured database) at the call sites and remove both `dbNamespace(String)` helpers. This is a readability convention; the current changes preserve test behavior.
